summary: Lightweight offline neural TTS based on Piper. 177 voices across 59 languages, including 5 curated community voices (Tamil, Sinhala, Kannada, Kurmanji); 26 voices have several speakers to choose from (2,801 in all). Each voice downloads on first use, 20-130 MB.
author: Subtitld add-on team
license: MIT (add-on glue) + GPL-3.0-or-later (Piper, OHF-voice/piper1-gpl) + per-model licenses (often CC-BY)
